actual: Installed versions and effective integration states recorded in ARCHITECTURE.md; original workbench retained.

actual: Native-controller test opens all seven areas, resizes and hides/reopens quick chat; actual app window found in OS inventory.

actual: Rejected correction retains 30; fresh approved correction yields 7 and historical change provenance.

actual: Concurrent replay gives one immutable receipt/effect; changed input denied; other space independent.

actual: Deletion failure blocks reads, retry removes active evidence and scrubs copies; restart/restore do not resurrect; write failures never report saved.

actual: Actual worker/foreign-owner/unknown-token HTTP probes denied before inspection; mid-read mutation and stale proof/approval rejected.

procedure_and_expected: Configure/test/enable a fixture plugin, inspect its operations and disable it. A dependent request is blocked; changing its account cannot silently retarget a saved operation.
Ask discovery to find a read/search operation. Inspect candidates and the permitted schema set. A similarly worded send/delete tool stays unauthorized; no-match/ambiguous requests stop.
Preview a fixture write, reject it and inspect zero calls. Approve a fresh exact payload: one receipt/effect appears. Changed payload, expired/revoked grant and approval replay are refused.
Propose a manifest/permission update. Reject it: active version/rights remain unchanged. Unreviewed tool names or skill-generated installation instructions cannot execute.
Fault the policy service and attempt an alternate execution bridge. The fixture records zero effects. No error turns into permission.
Ask a general question and a memory-grounded question from each interface. Real model output, current source citations and provider/model usage are visible; a UI animation is not proof of inference.
Ask an online question, review the data/query scope and approve it. Tavily returns actual sources used in the answer. A failed page/search is reported, including partial failures.
Ask to compare the selected Cedar documents using the current memory preference. Get a sourced answer, then correct the preference and verify the next answer uses the current value.

Run Lightning and Ultra through the intended account's actual IDs and a harmless structured lookup/result loop. Distinguish NVIDIA and Nebius routes; blocked access is not a pass on the other provider.

Cancel, exceed a small test budget and simulate a provider outage. Both windows show the same run state; no duplicate execution, false completion or unbounded retry occurs. Auxiliary inference obeys egress rules.
Delegate a Cedar research assignment. Inspect its bounded context, source IDs, snapshot and allowed operations; Maple records and main-memory credentials are absent.

Exercise controlled worker attempts to access memory APIs/files/stores, credentials, session search and alternative HTTP/tool bridges. Real probes are denied; a decorative “blocked” message is insufficient.
Run an allowed lookup and two independent cross-space tasks. Useful work succeeds while results/citations stay scoped.

Preview a runtime/configuration change and reject it. Current effective settings remain. A separately approved safe change is versioned, validated and reversible; pending grants are rechecked if it affects authority.
Ask for a research-and-draft workflow; inspect/edit its sources, step inputs, dependency order, limits and approval checkpoints. Save a version, close/reopen it and compare the exact definition.
Build the equivalent workflow using the form. Unknown operations, cycles, foreign accounts and invalid output bindings are rejected before calls run.
Run the permitted read/prepare steps and inspect actual progress/results. Independent reads can overlap, but a dependent step cannot consume an unvalidated/missing result.

Pause/cancel, restart around a checkpoint and resume safely. Completed operations are not blindly repeated. A possible external timeout-after-commit is marked outcome unknown and reconciled before retry.
Use an approved comparison/brief skill on two document sets. Procedure reuse does not copy one space's facts into the other.
Propose a skill from a completed workflow; inspect/reject the change, then approve a fresh valid version and roll it back. Old runs retain their bound version.
Try a skill that requests new credentials/tools or a forbidden send. It cannot expand the grant or install capabilities.
Leave quick chat open while using other windows; hide/summon it and expand a complex approval into the main app. One request has one shared run/approval identity.
Schedule a test brief a few minutes ahead with an approved local-draft destination. Verify the real output, occurrence receipt and next/last-run status; two accelerated occurrences happen once each.
Pause/revoke a recurring grant or change its output destination. The next unauthorized run stops for review; the old grant cannot authorize email or a different account.
Restart or recover from a missed due time under the selected catch-up/skip/ask policy. Do not replay every missed notification or a completed occurrence.

Change startup/background settings through the UI, then explicitly Quit. Inspect accurate process/job status. A short test is not proof of 24-hour availability; collect a real soak log before making that claim.
Inspect availability and a proposed event's calendar/timezone/times/attendees/notifications. Reject it: no event. Approve a fresh proposal: verify one real matching event.
Replay, change the account after preview, simulate uncertain completion and revoke access. No duplicate or silently retargeted event; blocked/unknown states stay visible.
Read an allowed repo with real source references; an ungranted repo is denied. Preview/reject an issue, then approve a fresh exact proposal and verify one real issue/receipt.
Test duplicate operation replay and a repository instruction requesting ungranted merge/Actions access. Neither produces an unauthorized effect.

If the optional workspace adapter is enabled, prepare a diff in an approved test folder, reject it, then approve a fresh change. Verify exact file effects and denied paths/commands. Otherwise mark this capability Unsupported/Not enabled, not passed.

Run the [memory manual sequence](MEMORY-QUALITY-CONTRACT.md) with current/history/conflict/missing cases, scope probes, mid-run correction and restart. Inspect actual values, source IDs and failure reports in both views.

Export one space; other spaces/secrets are absent. Forget evidence and test the defined delayed-event/reindex/isolated-restore path with tombstones applied before serving queries. No active resurrection; retained backup/audit limits are explicit.
Fault a store/provider/policy service, exhaust a small budget and use stop-all. No false save/result, unauthorized action or blind repeat of uncertain effects occurs.

Install/start from documented clean instructions in the chosen test environment. Demonstrate chat + Tavily + plugin configuration + edited workflow + approved memory/correction + skill reuse + scheduled draft + rejected/approved connector action.

Review actual quality/latency/cost samples, runtime versions, failed/blocked/unsupported features and recovery limits before accepting the MVP. Historical memory tests and a synthetic UI screenshot cannot replace this evidence.
